description: This server ships with a built-in OAuth client, so connecting normally needs only start_login + finish_login; call this for the details or to switch to your own client. The checklist adapts to the client in use: with the built-in client it is just the two login calls, and it adds the steps for your OWN client — creating a Google Cloud project and a Desktop-app OAuth client, publishing the consent screen (mandatory — Testing-mode refresh tokens die after 7 days), downloading the client JSON and handing its PATH to set_client. Works without any credentials; with your own client already configured it shortens to 'enable the API + log in' (one client serves the whole mcp-google-* line). Never asks the user to paste secrets into the chat.
name: setup_instructions
title: Setup instructions
